products.name: Flux Encoder
products.description: Queue, inspect and encode media with hardware-aware FFmpeg profiles.

entries: Synchronized package and suite metadata for the v0.8.18 alpha development release.
Uses the suite-owned rendering interfaces when receiving Flux Motion export jobs.

products.name: Flux Motion
products.description: Design broadcast graphics, titles and motion scenes in one focused workspace.

entries: Fixed project, title, template and embedded-asset loading from Windows paths containing Greek or other non-ASCII characters.
Standardized direct C++ filesystem access on explicit UTF-8 path conversion and retained Unicode-safe Qt save operations.
Validated the fix against the original Greek-path project and the existing serialization and preset I/O regression suites.

products.name: Flux Motion Plugin for OBS
products.description: Cue and render Flux Motion projects directly inside OBS Studio.

entries: Fixed Flux Motion project loading in OBS when the project or its parent folders contain Greek or other non-ASCII characters.
Fixed Unicode-path filesystem metadata and dependency-free WAV access in the shared OBS audio runtime.
Kept the existing project schema and authored content unchanged; no project migration is required.
